prompt: For a compatibility note, what protocol revisions can the Sendmux MCP package speak, and how is that different from its package version? Our setup guide lists mailbox, management, and sending tools, but a customer only sees some after OAuth—should they expect the whole catalogue? Also, are the clients named in the setup guide automatically certified?
assertions: The answer names the contract-supported protocol revisions 2025-11-25 and 2026-07-28.
The answer distinguishes the released sendmux-mcp package version 2.1.3 from protocol revisions and identifies 2.2.0 as the local candidate package metadata rather than a verified feature release.

The answer identifies the unpublished candidate contract catalogue as 64 tools (35 Mailbox, 23 Management, 6 Sending), keeps the released 2.1.3 catalogue separate as 54 tools (26 Mailbox, 22 Management, 6 Sending), and explains that OAuth grants and selected surfaces determine actual visible tools.
The answer does not treat a client listed in setup guidance as automatically certified.
